The main takeaway from our work is that
the mitoNEet model complex 52- is an excellent model for the biological cluster and that it is capable of PCET reactions at its unique {SN} ligand site.
a proton coupled electron transfer at the {SN}-ligated site of mitoNEET can be expected to be fast enough for a physiological relevance.
